steps.title: Prepare 3 M sodium citrate
steps.instruction: Weigh 44.12 g trisodium citrate dihydrate, dissolve in ~40 mL nuclease‑free water, stir until fully dissolved, adjust the final volume to 50 mL with water, and store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare 3 M sodium chloride
steps.instruction: Weigh 3.51 g sodium chloride, dissolve in ~40 mL nuclease‑free water, stir until fully dissolved, bring the volume to 50 mL with water, and store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare 70 % ethanol
steps.instruction: Mix 35 mL absolute ethanol with 15 mL nuclease‑free water to obtain a 70 % (v/v) ethanol solution; store as needed.

steps.title: Harvest knee joint tissues
steps.instruction: Sacrifice guinea pigs according to ethical guidelines, make a longitudinal skin incision, remove soft tissue with sterile forceps/scissors, displace the patella, collect synovial membrane from the suprapatellar region and inner capsule, cut cruciate ligaments to expose the tibiofemoral compartment and cartilage, briefly rinse the joint with 70 % ethanol, place cartilage and synovial pieces into 2 mL stainless‑steel vials containing three 3.2 mm beads, flash‑freeze in liquid nitrogen, and store at –80 °C (max 10–20 mg tissue per joint).

steps.title: Homogenize cartilage tissue
steps.instruction: Transfer frozen cartilage vials from –80 °C to liquid nitrogen, perform 3–4 dry‑grinding cycles of 15 s each on a Mini‑Beadbeater, cooling 2 min in liquid nitrogen between cycles, keep samples frozen, add 500 µL ice‑cold TRIzol® (or 300 µL for Protocol 3, 140 µL for Protocol 4, 300 µL for Protocol 5), bead‑beat two cycles of 15 s each with 2 min on‑ice cooling between cycles. Adjust the number of dry‑grinding cycles according to animal age (Table 1): 4 cycles for 3‑month (~20 mg), 3 cycles for 7‑month (~12–15 mg), 3 cycles for 12‑month (~10 mg).

steps.title: Homogenize synovium tissue
steps.instruction: Transfer frozen synovium vials from –80 °C to ice, add 500 µL ice‑cold TRIzol® (or 300 µL for Protocol 3, 140 µL for Protocol 4, 300 µL for Protocol 5), bead‑beat 10 cycles of 15 s each, cooling on ice 2 min after each cycle.

steps.title: RNA isolation – TRIzol method (Protocol 1)
steps.instruction: After homogenization, add an additional 500 µL ice‑cold TRIzol® to reach a total of 1 mL (adjust to 800 µL for ~10 mg tissue). Spin vials 30 s, transfer homogenate to a RNase‑free microcentrifuge tube, incubate 5–10 min at room temperature, centrifuge 12,000 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, transfer the clear supernatant to a new tube in a RNase‑free area, pass the homogenate through a 22G needle 10 times, add 200 µL chloroform (scale proportionally if TRIzol volume differs), shake vigorously, incubate 15 min at room temperature, centrifuge 12,000 × g for 15 min at 4 °C, transfer the upper aqueous phase to a new tube, add 0.5 vol 100 % isopropanol, add concentrated 3 M NaCl and 3 M sodium citrate to final concentrations of 1.2 M and 0.8 M respectively, add 200 µL chloroform again, repeat vortex and centrifugation as above, add ammonium acetate to 0.5 M, Glycoblue™ coprecipitant to 50 µg/mL, and 1 vol 100 % isopropanol, incubate at –20 °C for 15 min (or 2–3 h/overnight), centrifuge 12,000 × g for 15 min at 4 °C, discard supernatant, wash the pellet twice with 1 mL 75 % ethanol (centrifuge 8,000 × g for 5 min at 4 °C each wash), air‑dry 5–10 min at room temperature until the pellet is slightly translucent, resuspend in 20 µL nuclease‑free water, quantify RNA with a NanoDrop, and store at –80 °C.

steps.title: RNA isolation – TRIspin (Protocol 2)
steps.instruction: Proceed with Protocol 1 up to step 7, then add an equal volume of 100 % ethanol to the aqueous phase and mix gently. Load up to 680 µL of the mixture onto an RNeasy™ Mini column, discard the flow‑through, and repeat as needed. Perform on‑column DNase treatment using the RNase‑free DNase set according to the manufacturer’s instructions. Continue with the RNeasy™ Mini kit protocol and elute RNA in 20 µL nuclease‑free water; store at –80 °C.

steps.title: RNA isolation – RNeasy Mini (Protocol 3)
steps.instruction: After homogenization, add 300 µL RLT buffer to each stainless‑steel vial, then add 6 µL β‑mercaptoethanol per 600 µL RLT buffer (final 10 µL per mL) to protect RNA. Adjust the total volume to 600 µL for 10–20 mg tissue, then follow the Qiagen RNeasy™ Mini kit instructions, eluting RNA in 20 µL nuclease‑free water and storing at –80 °C.

steps.title: RNA isolation – RNAqueous kit (Protocol 4)
steps.instruction: After homogenization, add 100 µL lysis buffer from the RNAqueous™ Kit to each vial, bringing the total volume to 240 µL (10–12 µL per mg tissue). Transfer the homogenate to a new microcentrifuge tube and perform RNA isolation according to the RNAqueous™ kit manual; store the purified RNA at –80 °C.

steps.title: RNA isolation – Quick‑RNA Plus (Protocol 5)
steps.instruction: After homogenization, add 300 µL RNA Shield (from the Quick‑RNA™ Miniprep Plus kit) to reach a total of 600 µL for 10–20 mg tissue. Transfer the lysate to a new RNase‑free tube, add 30 µL Proteinase K mixed with 60 µL Proteinase K digestion buffer (prepare Proteinase K by reconstituting the lyophilized enzyme in 1.04 mL storage buffer), and incubate 3–4 h at room temperature. Centrifuge 12,000 × g for 5 min at 4 °C, transfer the supernatant to a 2 mL tube, add an equal volume of RNA lysis buffer, mix, and load onto a yellow Spin‑Away™ filter; centrifuge 11,000 × g for 30 s, repeat if necessary. Add an equal volume of 100 % ethanol, mix, and load onto a Zymo‑Spin™ IIICG column, centrifuging 11,000 × g for 30 s repeatedly until all sample passes through. Wash the column with 400 µL RNA wash buffer (centrifuge 11,000 × g 30 s), discard flow‑through, add 5 µL DNase I plus 75 µL DNA digestion buffer directly to the column, incubate 15 min at room temperature. Add 400 µL RNA prep buffer, centrifuge 11,000 × g 30 s and discard eluate. Wash with 680 µL RNA wash buffer (centrifuge 11,000 × g 30 s), discard flow‑through, then wash again with 400 µL RNA wash buffer (centrifuge 11,000 × g 1 min). Transfer the column to a new 1.5 mL tube and elute RNA: add 10 µL nuclease‑free water, incubate 10 min, centrifuge 11,000 × g 1 min; repeat with 5 µL water, incubate 5 min, centrifuge 11,000 × g 30 s. Perform a final dry spin 45 s at 8,000 × g to remove residual buffer. Store RNA at –80 °C.

steps.title: RNA quality control
steps.instruction: Measure RNA concentration and purity on a NanoDrop ND‑1000 (blank with nuclease‑free water). Record A260/280 ratios (aim 1.8–2.0) and A260/230 ratios (aim >1.7).

steps.title: RT‑qPCR assessment of RNA
steps.instruction: Synthesize cDNA for 5S rRNA using ~100 ng RNA with the miRCURY LNA RT kit per the manufacturer’s protocol. Perform qPCR with the miRCURY LNA SYBR Green kit and a custom guinea‑pig 5S rRNA assay in duplicate; thermal profile: 95 °C 2 min, then 40 cycles of 94 °C 10 s and 56 °C 60 s. Synthesize cDNA for β‑actin using 300–400 ng RNA with the iScript cDNA Synthesis kit. Run qPCR with primers Forward TAACTTGCGCGCAGAAAACG and Reverse GTCCTCGGCCACATTGTAGA. Include NO‑RT controls; a ΔCt ≥ 5 indicates effective genomic DNA removal. Verify a single melt peak, and analyze data with Bio‑Rad CFX Manager.
